platform_outcome.triager_reason_verbatim: I see no evidence that Airtable owns this bucket.
platform_outcome.lesson: Ground-truth refutation of ownership_verdict_effective=owned_human_override. The human override AND the discovery rule it spawned (rule-ownership_verifier-in_scope_bucket_derivation_override-951ed) both treated bucket-name-derivation-from-in-scope-host as sufficient ownership provenance. A bucket-takeover-specialist triager rejected exactly that premise. S3 bucket names are globally unique first-come-first-served; name derivation + a THIRD-PARTY repo reference + brand-plausible content is NOT proof of program ownership. Valid bucket-ownership proofs are: (1) DNS CNAME from a confirmed in-scope host to the bucket, (2) reference in a FIRST-PARTY (program-owned GH org) repo/config, or (3) explicit scope listing. Action taken: rule 951ed disabled; see memory/lessons.md and [[feedback-bucket-ownership-proof]].
